title: Designed Together / Identity Exploration
slide_intent: Compare related alternatives together so a team can judge which changes preserve recognition and which introduce a new character.
strategic_value: A shared wall of wordmarks, symbols and dots can help Google evaluate whether several forms belong to the same identity.
demonstration: Two designers review a wall covered with wordmark, lowercase-g, dot and geometric symbol explorations.
practical_value: Keep alternatives visible together during a review and distinguish exploratory concepts from the chosen identity.

content_islands.name: Reviewers
content_islands.spec: Keep the two people in the left foreground, with the pointing gesture leading toward the work.

content_islands.name: Exploration wall
content_islands.spec: Fill the right and background with pinned sheets of related wordmarks and symbols at several scales.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying article describes a collaborative sprint addressing small contexts, responsive motion and cross-product consistency.
reference_purposes.Expression: The photograph preserves visibly different exploratory treatments; it does not present all of them as approved assets.
